defs.name: BAD_FORM
defs.message: malformed @clause literal (missing kind / pattern / body, or guard not introduced by `when`)

defs.name: UNKNOWN_KIND

defs.note: 未知子句类别成员（仅 ClauseKind 的合法成员可用）

defs.name: PATTERN_KIND_MIX
defs.message: clause group mixes incompatible pattern kinds (literal / constructor / wildcard)
defs.note: 子句组内 pattern 形态不一致（字面量 / 构造子 / 通配混杂）

defs.name: MERGE_TYPE

defs.note: ++ 两侧须为同元类型（clause）数组

defs.name: ESCAPE
defs.message: clause value escapes to runtime; clause exists only in the compile-time phase
defs.note: clause 值逃逸到运行期（它只活在编译期）

defs.name: FAULT_MEMBER_REDECL
defs.message: duplicate fault member name within one group
defs.note: 组成员名重复（fault 批次 B1）

defs.name: ARG_NOT_CONST
defs.message: clause argument must be a compile-time foldable constant
defs.note: clause 实参必须是编译期可折叠常量

defs.name: SHADOWED
defs.message: clause is fully shadowed by an earlier unguarded clause
defs.note: 子句被更早的无守卫子句完全遮蔽（排重丢弃）

defs.name: FAULT_CLAUSE_GUARD
defs.message: `@clause(.fault, ...)` / `@clause(.repair, ...)` take no `when` guard (they are compile-time registrations, not match arms)
defs.note: 故障/修复子句不接受 `when` 守卫（fault 批次 B3）

defs.name: REPAIR_NAME_FORM
defs.message: the second operand of `@clause(.repair, ...)` must be a repair name of the form `.name`
defs.note: 修复子句的第二段必须是 `.名` 形态（fault 批次 B3）

defs.name: FAULT_PRED_FORM
defs.message: the predicate of `@clause(.fault, ...)` must be `.{...}` with only equality / relational field constraints
defs.note: 故障子句的谓词必须是 `.{...}` 且字段均为等值/关系约束（fault 批次 B3）

defs.name: FAULT_CLAUSE_IN_ARM
defs.message: fault / repair clauses cannot be spliced into a match arm chain
defs.note: 故障/修复子句不能作为 match 臂展开（fault 批次 B3）

defs.name: FAULT_UNKNOWN_GROUP
defs.message: `fault(E)!T` refers to an undeclared fault group; the group declaration must precede its use
defs.note: 未知故障组（fault 批次 B1）；组声明须先于使用

defs.name: FAULT_TYPE_MISMATCH
defs.message: the success type of `fault(E)!T` must be identical to the group's `over` type
defs.note: 成功类型与组的 over 类型不一致（fault 批次 B1 / A-26）

defs.name: FAULT_REPAIR_NAME_FORM
defs.message: a repair name must be written as `.name`
defs.note: repair 名必须写成 `.修法名`（fault 批次 B1）

defs.name: FAULT_MEMBER_NAME_PREFIX
defs.message: a fault member's full name must be `<GroupName>.<MemberName>`
defs.note: 成员全名前缀必须等于组名（fault 批次 B1）

defs.name: FAULT_DECL_MISSING_OVER
defs.message: a fault group declaration must be written as `fault <Name> over <Type> { ... }`
defs.note: 组声明缺 `over`（fault 批次 B1）

defs.name: FAULT_GROUP_REDECL
defs.note: 组名重复声明（fault 批次 B1）

defs.name: FAULT_PRED_FORM

defs.name: FAULT_PRED_DUP

defs.name: FAULT_REPAIR_DUP

defs.name: IN_RHS_NOT_RANGE

defs.name: VECTOR_LEN_NOT_COMTIME

defs.name: VECTOR_ELEM_NOT_NUMERIC

defs.name: VECTOR_LEN_RANGE

defs.name: VECTOR_SIZE_NOT_POW2

defs.note: @Vector 的总字节数（lane 数 x lane 宽度）必须是 2 的幂，否则无法映射为向量寄存器

defs.name: VECTOR_OP_MISMATCH
defs.message: vector elementwise operands must have identical lane count and lane type
defs.note: 向量逐元素运算要求两侧 lane 数与 lane 类型完全一致

defs.name: VECTOR_OP_UNSUPPORTED
defs.message: operator does not support vector operands
defs.note: 该运算符不支持向量操作数

defs.name: VECTOR_BUILTIN_ARG
defs.note: 向量内建（@splat / @reduce_* / @vlen）的实参非法

defs.name: VECTOR_WIDER_THAN_NATIVE
defs.message: vector is wider than the native SIMD register and will be split
defs.note: 向量宽于本机向量寄存器，将被后端拆分为多条指令（仍然正确，但不再单指令）

defs.name: TILE_ROWS_NOT_COMTIME
defs.message: tile row count must be a comptime constant
defs.note: @Tile 的行数必须是编译期常量（整数字面量、const 声明或常量算术）

defs.name: TILE_COLS_NOT_COMTIME
defs.message: tile column count must be a comptime constant
defs.note: @Tile 的列数必须是编译期常量（整数字面量、const 声明或常量算术）

defs.name: TILE_ELEM_NOT_NUMERIC
defs.message: tile element type must be a fixed-width numeric scalar
defs.note: @Tile 的元素类型必须是定宽数值标量（i8..i64 / u8..u64 / f32 / f64 / bool）

defs.name: TILE_DIM_RANGE
defs.message: tile rows and cols must be at least 1
defs.note: @Tile 的行数和列数都必须 >= 1

defs.name: TILE_FLAVOR_INVALID
defs.message: tile flavor must be hardware or simulate
defs.note: @Tile 的 flavor 必须是 hardware 或 simulate（编译期内建枚举值）

defs.name: TILE_OP_MISMATCH
defs.message: tile elementwise operands must have identical rows, cols and element type
defs.note: 瓦片逐元素运算要求两侧的行列数与元素类型完全一致

defs.name: TILE_OP_UNSUPPORTED
defs.message: operator does not support tile operands
defs.note: 该运算符不支持瓦片操作数

defs.name: TILE_WIDER_THAN_NATIVE
defs.message: hardware tile is wider than the native SIMD register and will fall back to scalar loops
defs.note: 硬件瓦片的总字节数不是本机向量寄存器宽度的整数倍，将退化为标量循环（仍然正确）

defs.name: TYPE_MISMATCH_CGEN
defs.note: codegen 期 type_info 仅支持 struct；legacy 由 T_TYPE_MISMATCH 拆出以保双标识唯一

defs.name: RESERVED
defs.note: 预留区间，当前无专用码

defs.name: DEVICE_BUILTIN_CTX
defs.message: device-only builtin used outside kernel context
defs.note: 设备专用内建 `X` 只能出现在 kernel fn 体内（host 上下文禁用）

defs.name: DEVICE_FORBID
defs.message: forbidden construct inside kernel (device safety subset)
defs.note: kernel 体内禁止该构造：闭包 / 动态分配(append) / host 运行时调用（docs/compiler/device-design.md §8）

defs.name: DEVICE_RECURSION
defs.note: kernel 调用另一 kernel/自身：设备安全子集禁止递归与调用图成环

defs.name: DEVICE_BUILTIN_ARITY
defs.note: 设备内建实参数与声明不符

defs.name: ARRAY_LEN_UNINFERABLE
defs.message: array length placeholder `[_]` cannot be inferred here
defs.note: `[_]` 数组长度占位只能用在带初始化器的变量/常量声明中

defs.name: UNKNOWN_MEMBER
defs.note: 枚举/变体/位域类型没有该成员名（请检查拼写）

defs.name: PACKED_FIELD_NOT_INT
defs.message: packed struct field must be an integer type
defs.note: packed struct 的字段必须是整型（bool 或 uN/iN，N 即位宽）；非整型字段无法参与按位打包，请先化为 uN 字段或改用普通 struct

defs.name: PACKED_TOO_WIDE
defs.message: packed struct exceeds its underlying integer width
defs.note: packed struct 总位宽超过底层整型容量（上限 64 位）；请拆分为多个 packed struct

defs.name: VALUE_LOOP_BREAK_NEEDS_ELSE
defs.message: value-loop `break <expr>` requires a matching loop `else` clause to supply the no-break value
defs.note: 带值 break 必须配合循环 `else` 完成子句提供「无中断路径」的值

defs.name: VALUE_LOOP_PLAIN_BREAK
defs.message: plain `break` (without value) is not allowed in a value loop; use `break <expr>`
defs.note: 值循环中的 break 必须带值（break <expr>）；普通 break 仅用于非值循环

defs.name: NON_VALUE_LOOP_IN_EXPR
defs.message: a loop used as an expression must be a value loop (with `else` clause or `break <value>` in body)
defs.note: 循环出现在表达式位置必须是「值循环」：需带 `else` 完成子句，或体含 `break <值>`

defs.name: FAULT_OK_ARITY
defs.message: `Ok` takes exactly one argument (the success value)
defs.note: `Ok` 的实参数目必须为 1（成功值）；故障联合体构造器的成功路径（fault 批次 B4a / R-opt3）

defs.name: FAULT_ERR_NON_CLAUSE
defs.message: every argument of `Err(...)` must be an `@clause(...)` literal
defs.note: `Err(...)` 的实参必须是 `@clause(...)` 字面量（fault 批次 B4a / D-12）

defs.name: FAULT_ERR_FAULT_CLAUSE
defs.message: `Err(...)` needs exactly one `@clause(.fault, ...)` naming the raised member
defs.note: `Err(...)` 须恰好一条 `@clause(.fault, ...)` 指名抛出的故障成员（fault 批次 B4a）

defs.name: FAULT_ERR_MEMBER
defs.message: the raised fault member does not match the group declaration
defs.note: `Err(...)` 的全名不在组内 / 组名不符 / 谓词与组声明不恒等（fault 批次 B4a / A-2 A-22 A-25）

defs.name: FAULT_ERR_REPAIR_SLOT
defs.message: repair name is not declared for the raised fault member
defs.note: `@clause(.repair, ...)` 的修法名不属于本次抛出的故障成员（fault 批次 B4a / A-26）

defs.name: FAULT_ERR_CLAUSE_KIND
defs.note: `Err(...)` 只接受 .fault / .repair 两类子句（fault 批次 B4a）
